title: Redaction form XObject recursion and inline image decoding
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-edit; a secret drawn inside a form XObject is removed and an inline image is pixel-redacted, with unsupported content still failing closed
notes: Quality follow-up from T-0237, which removes content in page content streams and image XObjects but deliberately fails closed on form XObjects and inline images. This task recurses `/Subtype /Form` content with depth and cycle caps, applies marks in form space through the form matrix and CTM, and decodes plus redacts inline `BI/ID/EI` images for the same supported formats (PNG/JPEG-equivalent 8-bit Gray/RGB/Indexed/ICCBased 1/3). Anything still unsupported keeps the existing fail-closed behaviour rather than silently leaving content. Tests must prove a form-drawn secret is gone after redaction and that an inline image is pixel-redacted. This is a quality follow-up, not a dependency of T-0257 or T-0263. Round A delivered: form XObject recursion, nested/cycle/depth/visit fail-closed, compressed-form decode, PDFium render proof; Round B pending: inline image (BI/ID/EI) decoding.
